+# baseChangeTargetSheafComparison
+
+## Reason
+
+Keep every existing signature and comparison morphism unchanged, but replace expensive
+unfolding and automatic isomorphism inference by a proved API lemma. The original
+sandbox proof attempted broad dsimp/simp on concrete derived functors and timed out.
+The comparison remains the same three mathematical isomorphisms;
+baseChangeTargetFunctorHigherImageIso and higherDirectImageMapIso spell out the
+canonical functor-object conversions. The coefficient-morphism API constructs the
+nested functor maps directly with explicit higher-image objects; its equations are
+proved by reflexivity. The new proof of IsIso is proof irrelevant. The inverse pullback map also keeps the same data: only its commuting
+triangle proof is replaced by the explicit symmetric lift_fst equation.
+
+The added projection lemma targetPullbackComparison_snd packages an existing
+pullback.lift_snd computation. Local transparency settings affect this file only.
+No target statement or underlying mathematical definition changes meaning; the
+existing target statement review does not reopen.
+
+## Old

+```lean
+noncomputable def targetPullbackComparisonInv (U : Over T) :
+    pullback (U.hom ≫ g) p ⟶ ((Over.pullback (pullback.fst g p)).obj U).left :=

+```

+noncomputable def baseChangeTargetSheafComparison (U : Over T) :
+    (baseChangeTargetFunctor Λ (pullback.fst (U.hom ≫ g) p)
+      (pullback.snd (U.hom ≫ g) p) q).obj (((U.hom)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj F) ≅
+    higherDirectImage Λ
+      (((Over.pullback (pullback.fst g p)).obj U).hom ≫ pullback.snd g p) q
+      (((((Over.pullback (pullback.fst g p)).obj U).hom)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj
+        (((pullback.fst g p)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj F)) := by
+  let a := targetPullbackComparison p g U
+  let h := pullback.snd (U.hom ≫ g) p
+  let h' := ((Over.pullback (pullback.fst g p)).obj U).hom ≫ pullback.snd g p
+  let w : a ≫ h = h' := by
+    dsimp only [a, h, h']
+    unfold targetPullbackComparison
+    exact pullback.lift_snd _ _ _

+  have : IsIso t := by
+    dsimp [t, higherDirectImageTransition]
+    infer_instance
+  exact (baseChangeTargetFunctorIso Λ (pullback.fst (U.hom ≫ g) p) h q).app _
+    ≪≫ asIso t

+Compose along cV followed by b using the same law, with coefficient maps fV and e.
+Both routes are the transition along the composite map to YV. The equation ws
+identifies these maps; the upperStarComp with this named composite records the
+required transport. The hypothesis wc identifies the two coefficient suffixes.
+Apply the single functor, RhZU_* and degree-q homology to that equality and paste
+it with the two composition identities. This proves the square without requiring
+any arrow to be an isomorphism, any sheaf to be nonzero, or q to be nonnegative. -/
+theorem higherDirectImage_coefficient_square
+    {X YV YU ZV ZU : Scheme.{u}}
+    (a : YU ⟶ YV) (b : ZU ⟶ ZV) (cV : ZV ⟶ YV) (cU : ZU ⟶ YU)
+    (hV : YV ⟶ X) (hU : YU ⟶ X) (kV : ZV ⟶ X) (kU : ZU ⟶ X)
+    (wa : a ≫ hV = hU) (wb : b ≫ kV = kU)
+    (wV : cV ≫ hV = kV) (wU : cU ≫ hU = kU)
+    (ws : cU ≫ a = b ≫ cV) (q : ℤ)
+    (FV : Sheaf YV.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
+    (FU : Sheaf YU.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
+    (GV : Sheaf ZV.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
+    (GU : Sheaf ZU.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
+    (d : ((a)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj FV ⟶ FU)
+    (fV : ((cV)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj FV ⟶ GV)
+    (fU : ((cU)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj FU ⟶ GU)
+    (e : ((b)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj GV ⟶ GU)
+    (wc : (upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) cU a).hom.app FV ≫
+        ((cU)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map d ≫ fU =
+      (upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) b cV (cU ≫ a) ws).hom.app FV ≫
+        ((b)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map fV ≫ e) :
+    (higherDirectImageTransition Λ a hV hU wa q FV ≫
+      higherDirectImageMap Λ hU q d) ≫
+      (higherDirectImageTransition Λ cU hU kU wU q FU ≫
+        higherDirectImageMap Λ kU q fU) =
+    (higherDirectImageTransition Λ cV hV kV wV q FV ≫
+      higherDirectImageMap Λ kV q fV) ≫
+      (higherDirectImageTransition Λ b kV kU wb q GV ≫
+        higherDirectImageMap Λ kU q e) := by
+  have hh :
+    (higherDirectImageTransition Λ a hV hU wa q FV ≫
+      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).map
+        (R+((hU)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
+          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map d))) ≫
+      (higherDirectImageTransition Λ cU hU kU wU q FU ≫
+        (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).map
+        (R+((kU)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
+          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map fU))) =
+    (higherDirectImageTransition Λ cV hV kV wV q FV ≫
+      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).map
+        (R+((kV)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
+          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map fV))) ≫
+      (higherDirectImageTransition Λ b kV kU wb q GV ≫
+        (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).map
+        (R+((kU)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
+          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map e))) := by
+    have ha := higher_direct_image_transition_composition Λ a cU hV hU kU wa wU q
+      FV FU GU d fU
+    have hb := composition_of_eq Λ cV b hV kV kU wV wb (cU ≫ a) ws q
+      FV GV GU fV e
+    apply ha.symm.trans
+    apply Eq.trans _ hb
+    exact congrArg (fun z ↦
+      higherDirectImageTransition Λ (cU ≫ a) hV kU
+        (by rw [Category.assoc, wa, wU]) q FV ≫
+          (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).map
+            (R+((kU)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
+              ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map z))) wc
+  bc_structural_exact hh
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Etale

+private meta def toEq (h : Lean.Expr) : Lean.MetaM Lean.Expr := do
+  let type ← Lean.Meta.inferType h

+-- Adapt the kernel-checked congruence method of HigherDirectImageTransitionCoreComposition.
+-- Build congruence proofs before reducing the large derived-category objects.
+private meta def congrProofs
+    (cache : IO.Ref (Std.HashMap (Lean.Expr × Lean.Expr) Lean.Expr))
+    (pairs : Array (Lean.Expr × Lean.Expr × Lean.Expr)) :
+    Nat → Lean.Expr → Lean.Expr → Lean.MetaM Lean.Expr
+  | 0, a, b => do
+    throwError "congruence depth exhausted: {a} versus {b}"

+      let a := a.consumeMData
+      let b := b.consumeMData

+      if a.isFVar then

+          return ← congrProofs cache pairs n value b
+      if b.isFVar then
+        if let some value := (← Lean.Meta.getFVarLocalDecl b).value? then
+          return ← congrProofs cache pairs n a value

+        | e' => e'

+      let b' := normalize b
+      if a != a' || b != b' then
+        return ← congrProofs cache pairs n a' b'
+      for (x, y, h) in pairs do
+        if a == x && b == y then return h
+        if a == y && b == x then return ← Lean.Meta.mkAppM ``HEq.symm #[h]

+        let hs ← Lean.Meta.mkAppM ``Eq.symm #[args[2]!]

+        let hs ← Lean.Meta.mkAppM ``Eq.symm #[args[2]!]
+        let hc ← Lean.Meta.mkAppM ``cast_heq #[hs, args[3]!]

+        let hc ← Lean.Meta.mkAppM ``HEq.symm #[hc]
+        return ← Lean.Meta.mkAppM ``HEq.trans #[ht, hc]

+      let a' ← expandProjection a
+      let b' ← expandProjection b
+      if a != a' || b != b' then
+        return ← congrProofs cache pairs n a' b'
+      let af := a.getAppFn
+      let bf := b.getAppFn
+      let aa := a.getAppArgs
+      let ba := b.getAppArgs
+      if af.isConstOf ``CategoryTheory.Preadditive.mk &&
+          bf.isConstOf ``CategoryTheory.Abelian.toPreadditive then
+        return ← Lean.Meta.mkHEqRefl a
+      if bf.isConstOf ``CategoryTheory.Preadditive.mk &&
+          af.isConstOf ``CategoryTheory.Abelian.toPreadditive then
+        return ← Lean.Meta.mkHEqRefl a
+      if af.isConstOf ``CategoryTheory.Functor.mk &&
+          bf.isConstOf ``CategoryTheory.Functor.ShiftSequence.sequence then
+        return ← Lean.Meta.mkHEqRefl a
+      if bf.isConstOf ``CategoryTheory.Functor.mk &&
+          af.isConstOf ``CategoryTheory.Functor.ShiftSequence.sequence then
+        return ← Lean.Meta.mkHEqRefl a
+      let sameHead := af == bf || (af.isConst && bf.isConst &&
+        af.constName! == bf.constName! && (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq af bf))
+      if !sameHead || aa.size != ba.size then
+        let isProjection (f : Lean.Expr) : Lean.MetaM Bool := do
+          if f.isConst then
+            return (← Lean.getProjectionFnInfo? f.constName!).isSome
+          return false
+        if !(← isProjection af) then
+          if let some a' ← Lean.Meta.unfoldDefinition? a (ignoreTransparency := true) then
+            return ← congrProofs cache pairs n a' b
+        if !(← isProjection bf) then
+          if let some b' ← Lean.Meta.unfoldDefinition? b (ignoreTransparency := true) then

+          let some e' ← Lean.Meta.withTransparency .instances
+              (Lean.Meta.unfoldDefinition? e (ignoreTransparency := true)) | return none
+          let some f ← Lean.Meta.withTransparency .all
+              (Lean.Meta.reduceProj? e'.getAppFn) | return none
+          let e'' := Lean.mkAppN f e'.getAppArgs
+          if e'' == e then return none
+          if e''.getAppFn.isProj then
+            let .proj typeName index major := e''.getAppFn | return none
+            let info := Lean.getStructureInfo (← Lean.getEnv) typeName
+            let p ← Lean.Meta.mkProjection major info.fieldNames[index]!
+            let e''' := Lean.mkAppN p e''.getAppArgs
+            if e''' == e then return none
+          return some e''
+        if ← isProjection af then
+          if let some a' ← reduceProjection a then
+            return ← congrProofs cache pairs n a' b
+        if ← isProjection bf then
+          if let some b' ← reduceProjection b then
+            return ← congrProofs cache pairs n a b'
+        if ← Lean.Meta.withTransparency .all (Lean.Meta.isDefEq a b) then
+          return ← Lean.Meta.mkHEqRefl a
+        throwError "different heads: {a} versus {b}"
+      let expandCompositeObj (e : Lean.Expr) : Lean.MetaM Lean.Expr := do
+        let args := e.getAppArgs
+        if e.isAppOf ``CategoryTheory.Functor.obj && args.size ≥ 2 then
+          let functor := args[args.size - 2]!
+          if functor.isAppOf ``CategoryTheory.Functor.comp then
+            let fs := functor.getAppArgs
+            let x ← Lean.Meta.mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.obj
+              #[fs[fs.size - 2]!, args.back!]
+            return ← Lean.Meta.mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.obj #[fs.back!, x]
+        return e
+      let a' ← expandCompositeObj a
+      let b' ← expandCompositeObj b
+      if a != a' || b != b' then
+        return ← congrProofs cache pairs n a' b'
+      let mut first := 0
+      while first < aa.size && aa[first]! == ba[first]! do
+        first := first + 1
+      let f := Lean.mkAppN af (aa.extract 0 first)
+      let ct ← Lean.Meta.mkHCongrWithArity f (aa.size - first)
+      let mut args := #[]
+      for i in [first:aa.size] do
+        let h ← congrProofs cache pairs n aa[i]! ba[i]!
+        let h ← if ct.argKinds[i - first]! == .eq then
+          toEq h else pure h
+        args := args.push aa[i]! |>.push ba[i]! |>.push h
+      return Lean.mkAppN ct.proof args
+    let h ← compute
+    cache.modify fun m => m.insert (a, b) h
+    return h
